title: Listening Drill — Tea tasting event — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Tea tasting event — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on tea tasting event. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Tuesday. The group will now meet on Wednesday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the courtyard gate; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is water cup. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow forty-five minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check steeping time before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed tasting notes so we can offer feedback.
